item.title: Club FM’s 13th Edition of Bhagyavan brings Onam celebrations to life across Kerala
item.dc:creator: MN4U Bureau
item.description: Kochi: Club FM, the radio platform of Mathrubhumi Group, has launched the 13th edition of its popular Onam roadshow, Bhagyavan, adding to the festive celebrations across Kerala. The 13th edition of Bhagyavan was flagged off at Forum Mall, Kochi, in the presence of rapper Vedan and actor Jibin Gopinath. The launch event was attended by representatives from partner brands and organisations, including Kia, Nolta Kottaram Group of Companies, Achayans Gold, Forum Kochi, Mathrubhumi and Club FM. As part of this year’s edition, a specially designed Bhagyavan van will travel across various districts of Kerala, bringing the roadshow closer to consumers and listeners during the Onam season. Participants will be invited to take part in a series of digital games and complete three levels, with a chance to win a cash prize of ₹1 lakh along with other prizes. The 13th edition combines on-ground engagement with digital games, offering participants an interactive festive experience while creating opportunities for brands to connect with consumers across Kerala. The roadshow is supported by a line-up of brands and organisations, including Kia, Medimix, Kosamattam Finance, Wayfarer Films’ I Am Game, Nolta, Swarnamukhi Gold & Diamonds, Kerala Police, MVD Kerala Road Safety Authority and Achayans Gold. [caption id="attachment_2504894" align="alignleft" width="200"] Devika Shreyams Kumar[/caption] Flagging off the roadshow, Devika Shreyams Kumar, Director, Digital Operations, Mathrubhumi Group, said, “Bhagyavan has grown into one of Kerala’s most popular roadshows. Every year, thousands of Malayalis participate and take-home exciting gifts. Over the years, we have also seen an exceptional rise in the number of brands associating with the roadshow. We always strive to deliver maximum value to our brand partners by providing meaningful opportunities to engage and connect with consumers.” [caption id="attachment_2506051" align="alignright" width="200"] Jayakrishnan[/caption] N Jayakrishnan, General Manager, Club FM, said, “The on-ground roadshow has become synonymous with Onam celebrations in Kerala. Every year, we strive to make the experience bigger, more exciting, and more engaging for our listeners and participants. The game is designed around elements of surprise, excitement, and fun, making it an enjoyable experience for everyone involved. At the same time, Bhagyavan offers our brand partners a powerful platform to build stronger connections with consumers and enhance their brand presence.” With its 13th edition, Bhagyavan continues to combine festive entertainment, audience participation and brand engagement, taking the Onam experience to consumers across Kerala through its roadshow format.

item.title: Storvekaft celebrates Onam with ‘Pigeon Onam Combotsavam’ featuring Pearle Maaney as ‘Combo Rani’
item.dc:creator: MN4U Bureau
item.description: Bengaluru: Stovekraft Limited, the kitchen and home appliances company behind the Pigeon brand, has launched its Onam campaign, ‘Pigeon Onam Combotsavam’, featuring Malayalam actress, lyricist and YouTuber Pearle Maaney as the campaign’s ‘Combo Rani’. The festive campaign celebrates the idea of combinations that are integral to Onam celebrations in Kerala, while highlighting curated cookware and kitchen appliance combos offered by Pigeon during the festival season. The campaign draws inspiration from popular combinations associated with Malayali households, including chai and parippu vada, kasavu saree and mallipoo, puttu and kadala curry, as well as families coming together for the traditional Onasadya. Pearle Maaney, who is known for her work as an actress, content creator and lifestyle personality, features as the ‘Combo Rani’ in the campaign. The campaign positions her as a representation of contemporary Malayali families and their connection with food, cooking, family gatherings and festive traditions. [caption id="attachment_2476941" align="alignleft" width="200"] Rajendra Gandhi[/caption] Commenting on the campaign, Rajendra Gandhi, Managing Director, Stovekraft Limited, said, "Onam is a celebration of togetherness, traditions and the simple combinations that bring families closer every Onam. With Pigeon's Onam Combotsavam, we wanted to bring that spirit into every home through thoughtfully created kitchen combinations that offer greater value and convenience." As part of the campaign, Pigeon has introduced several festive combinations, including an Induction Cooktop with a 3L Pressure Cooker, Kitchen Chimney with a 2 Burner Glass Cooktop, Idiyappam Maker with Glass Cooktop, Non-stick Tawa with the Appachetty, 3L Pressure Cooker with Cast Iron Appachetty, and Idiyappam Maker with the Cerrasteel Tawa. For consumers looking for a broader kitchen upgrade, the brand has also introduced an Onam Family Pack comprising an Induction Cooktop, Appachetty, 3L Pressure Cooker, 550W Mixer Grinder, Non-stick Fry Pan & Tawa and a 2 Burner Glass Cooktop at a discounted price. In addition to the combo offerings, consumers can avail themselves of festive offers on Pigeon products including Digital Air Fryers, Electric Rice Cookers, Nutri Blenders and Mixer Grinders. The ‘Pigeon Onam Combotsavam’ campaign will run across Kerala during the Onam festive season. The promotional combos will be available through Pigeon Exclusive Outlets and leading cookware and appliance stores across the state.

item.title: Oriflame names Kenneth Benaim Campbell as Chief Executive Officer
item.dc:creator: MN4U Bureau
item.description: Mumbai: Oriflame, the Swedish beauty and wellbeing brand, has appointed Kenneth Benaim Campbell as Chief Executive Officer, effective immediately. Kenneth joins Oriflame with more than 30 years of international leadership experience and a career spanning the global beauty industry. He spent 27 years with L’Oréal, where he held senior leadership roles across Europe, Asia and Latin America. During his tenure at L’Oréal, Kenneth led businesses across mature and high-growth markets including Germany, Spain, the United Kingdom, Mexico, Taiwan, China and India. Most recently, he served as President for Europe and North America at Lipton Teas & Infusions, where he led one of the world’s largest branded beverage businesses through a period of transformation and growth. Kenneth brings experience in people leadership, international business, consumer-focused growth and organisational transformation to his new role at Oriflame. [caption id="attachment_2516539" align="alignleft" width="199"] Robert Bensoussan[/caption] Robert Bensoussan, Chairman of the Oriflame Board, commented, “Kenneth is an exceptional international leader with deep beauty industry expertise, extensive global experience and a strong track record of building brands, developing people and delivering results. The Board unanimously believes he is the right leader to guide Oriflame through its next phase of development and growth.” Kenneth succeeds Anna Malmhake, who has decided to step down following three years as CEO and President. During her tenure, Malmhake oversaw the completion of Oriflame’s recapitalisation and launched the company’s transformation strategy. Robert Bensoussan added, “I would also like to thank Anna for her leadership and commitment during an important period in Oriflame’s history. Under her leadership, the company successfully completed its refinancing and made significant progress in strengthening the business and advancing its transformation.” Kenneth Benaim Campbell said, “I am honoured to join Oriflame. What attracted me most is the company’s unique entrepreneurial model, strong beauty heritage, talented people and global community of Beauty Entrepreneurs. I look forward to working closely with teams around the world to build on the progress already achieved and unlock the significant opportunities ahead.” [caption id="attachment_2516541" align="alignright" width="200"] Edyta Kurek[/caption] Edyta Kurek, Senior Vice President and GM, Oriflame India, said, “As we transition into this next phase of growth, we look forward to working closely with Kenneth and drawing on the depth of experience and perspective he brings from the beauty industry and across diverse markets. With more than 30 years in India, Oriflame has built a strong business and a growing community of consumers and Beauty Entrepreneurs, and we look forward to building on this foundation and creating greater value as we continue to grow Oriflame in India.” As Oriflame approaches its 60th anniversary, the company remains focused on strengthening its business, supporting its Beauty Entrepreneurs, advancing its transformation plans and pursuing sustainable long-term growth.
